subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should this PR keep the legacy no-code persisted diagnostic cleanup in runtime stale detection, or should that upgrade cleanup move to doctor/migration-owned code before merge?
rationale: The explicit marker follows prior maintainer direction, but the legacy runtime branch is a compatibility-sensitive persisted-state policy choice that green CI and source review cannot settle alone.

options.title: Accept Runtime Legacy Detection After Proof
options.body: Merge the current shape once the contributor adds redacted latest-head real behavior proof for the legacy no-code SQLite upgrade path.

options.title: Move Legacy Cleanup To Doctor
options.body: Keep the explicit marker and schema fix but remove the no-code runtime branch and handle pre-code rows through a migration or doctor repair path.

options.title: Land Explicit Marker Only
options.body: Narrow this PR to new orphan-source-path diagnostics and track legacy no-code rows separately.

recommendation.title: Accept Runtime Legacy Detection After Proof
recommendation.body: Merge the current shape once the contributor adds redacted latest-head real behavior proof for the legacy no-code SQLite upgrade path.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc gave the prior explicit-marker direction and is tied to the current plugin registry code history.
